diseases.name: Childhood pneumonia (severe if chest indrawing)
diseases.inv: Chest X-ray if unclear, oxygen saturation, CBC; follow WHO/IMCI classification.
diseases.tool: WHO IMCI classifies childhood illness by age and signs; use the official charts.
diseases.alt: Bronchiolitis, asthma, foreign body, TB, heart failure

diseases.name: Bronchiolitis / wheezy illness
diseases.alt: Pneumonia, asthma, foreign body, heart failure

diseases.name: Simple febrile seizure
diseases.inv: Clinical; look for the source of fever.

diseases.name: Neonatal sepsis
diseases.inv: Urgent paediatric review; blood culture, CBC, glucose; do not delay referral.
diseases.alt: Hypoglycaemia, congenital heart disease, metabolic disease

diseases.name: Intestinal obstruction / malrotation in infant
diseases.inv: Emergency surgical review; abdominal X-ray, ultrasound/contrast study.

diseases.name: Congenital heart disease with heart failure
diseases.inv: Oxygen saturation, chest X-ray, ECG, echocardiography.

flags.text: Chest indrawing, grunting or unable to drink: WHO danger signs, urgent referral
Seizure with neck stiffness, bulging fontanelle or prolonged drowsiness: possible meningitis, urgent care
Baby 28 days or younger who is lethargic, febrile/cold or breathing fast: possible neonatal sepsis, urgent referral
Green (bilious) vomiting in an infant: possible obstruction, surgical emergency
